svg.title: GP1 starter tree
svg.desc: A sequence named one_cell, drawn as an orange box on the left, with seven gray leaves in order from top to bottom: submit_report (tag 1, a service leaf), wait_for_beam (tag 2, a subscriber leaf), pick_from_conveyor (tag 3, an action leaf), place_on_tester (tag 3), read_voltage (tag 2), pick_from_tester (tag 3) and place_in_slot (tag 3).
